name: SatQuery AG-04 demo monitoring areas
note: Demo monitoring RECTANGLES over Manipur valley farmland, drawn by the team for the prototype. They are NOT administrative boundaries. Place names come from OpenStreetMap Nominatim reverse geocoding of each rectangle's centre (ODbL, checked 2026-10-08). District boundaries will come from Member B's verified dataset.
